about: Test vectors of the GTT host rule (tools/crucible_cli/hostcheck.py gtt_verdict). tests/test_host_check.py reads this file; a port of the rule to another language reads the same file. Inputs: gtt_total_bytes is the list of mem_info_gtt_total values of /sys/class/drm/card*/device (null: not readable), memtotal_kb is MemTotal of /proc/meminfo (null: not readable), pack is the pack name or null (no pack rule), container is true for a check that reads only sysfs and /proc/meminfo, params_on_cmdline is true when /proc/cmdline holds amdgpu.gttsize and ttm.pages_limit (null: not read). Output: status (pass, warn or fail), code, reason (the exact text) and params (the two kernel parameters for this machine).

output.reason: Crucible needs a 96 GB or 128 GB machine. This machine has 61 GiB. The 3.05 pack with one session of 32,768 tokens holds about 63 GB of GPU memory, and the engine keeps 9 GiB free for the system at start. If the BIOS gives the GPU a large dedicated memory (UMA frame buffer), set it to the smallest value (512 MB): the GPU uses the system memory through the GTT.
